eye_marks: the eyes have stray marks, odd spots or smudges
catchlight_odd: the catch lights (white highlights) in the eyes look odd, doubled or misplaced
iris_target: the irises look like a target or a set of rings
pupil_odd: the pupils look odd (too big, too dark, wrong shape)
lash_broken: the lash or lid lines look broken, jagged or uneven
white_odd: the whites of the eyes have odd shapes or edges
iris_flat: the irises look flat and pasted-on
eyes_lifeless: the eyes look lifeless or glassy
nose_odd: the nose looks odd (shape, highlight or line)
